summary.text: James Rogers is a Republican attorney and candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 10 (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Republican primary on July 21, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a constitutional attorney who is running on a slate with Representative Justin Olson.

paragraphs.text: James Rogers earned a graduate degree from the University of Cambridge in 2008 and a law degree from Harvard Law School in 2009, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a sixth-generation Arizonan and father of four.

Rogers said in the survey that his legal work has included litigating election integrity cases and suing Mesa Public Schools over its handling of students' gender transitions, and that he helped draft legislation at the Arizona Legislature, including Proposition 314, the Secure the Border Act.

He listed his priorities as making it affordable for young Arizonans to start families, changing election laws, school policy on gender identity, opposing abortion, fighting illegal immigration and protecting Second Amendment rights.
He listed endorsements from Turning Point Action, the Arizona Free Enterprise Club, the Arizona Freedom Fund, the Republican Liberty Caucus, Rep. Justin Olson and Rep. Ralph Heap.
